purpose: Screenshots for building a 16:9 PPTX with Claude
notes: All screenshots are real captures (Samsung S24 Ultra + Waterfox).
Phone screenshots are 1080x2340 portrait; dashboard 1230x880; team cards 1600x1450.
Do not stretch the images; use dark navy #081120 backgrounds for phone shots.
The logo appears only as the app icon (00_app_icon.png), not inside the app UI.
The menu is 8x8x8 = 512 problems, 3 taps: category -> subcategory -> problem.
Quorum: 1 vote for low/medium, 2 votes for high/critical.
Accessibility profiles: blind, mute, deaf, colorblind, motor, cognitive.
Quorum is one responder per primary department involved (not a fixed 2).
